usage: cli.py [-h] [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR] [--out-file OUT_FILE]
              [--audit-recursion] [--no-pdf]
              n

n-loop Wilson loop diagram pipeline

positional arguments:
  n                     Number of loops

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Output directory
  --out-file OUT_FILE   Use existing QGRAF .out file (skip generator)
  --audit-recursion     Export pre-2PI recursion audit only (loops 1-3;
                        separate filenames)
  --no-pdf              Skip optional pdflatex rendering; preserve all
                        mathematical exports

usage: cli.py [-h] --source SOURCE [--out-dir OUT_DIR] [--orbit-id ORBIT_ID]
              [--type TYPE] [--all] [--suffix SUFFIX] [--tgv-ibp]
              [--package-initial] [--double-tgv-forms] [--double-tgv-operator]
              [--package-only] [--fgv-compat-out-dir FGV_COMPAT_OUT_DIR]

montopar — direct parameter-space integral generation

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --source SOURCE       Path to orbit_definitions.json
  --out-dir OUT_DIR     Output directory (default: <repo_root>/workspaces/)
  --orbit-id ORBIT_ID   Process a specific orbit by ID
  --type TYPE           Process all orbits of a given emission type (e.g. 4e,
                        6e, 3e-3g, 4e-4g)
  --all                 Process all orbits (pure, tgv, fourv)
  --suffix SUFFIX       Suffix for output filename (e.g. '_new' writes
                        montopar_new.json)
  --tgv-ibp, --gamma1-ibp
                        Add contour-IBP sums for TGV, mixed, double-TGV, TGV-
                        Pi1, and Gamma1 orbits
  --package-initial     Write one montopar-initial.json package for the
                        selected emission type(s)
  --double-tgv-forms    Add compact and analytically reduced double-TGV C/J
                        forms; retain all raw fields
  --double-tgv-operator
                        Add an unapplied parent-position double-TGV operator;
                        retain all scalar fields
  --package-only        Build the initial package from existing montopar.json
                        files without regeneration
  --fgv-compat-out-dir FGV_COMPAT_OUT_DIR
                        Also regenerate FGV final/state/export.dimreduce files
                        under this output root
